Page 136 Cont.
June 25 Mrs. Margaret -47 - Cancer of throat ..... Drs. say: "Nothing can be done." He, husband, not Catholic. He promises to look into religion earnestly if wife is spared - the two enrolled To-day.
Rob. Molloy - 26 - of Glasgo Scotland - on back for 15 months - kidney & .... given up as hoeless a year ago when prayd for and En- rolled - able to walk again.
26 Thanks - Mrs. Ellen Morin - 37 - was 21 1bs over-weight - four Drs. agreed on it being tuomer of some kind .... She and Husband promised to read "City of God", if things went in her favor. (For time Dr's figured on pregnency) when Specialist saw her - the surgon - he sent her home. Back now to normal size.
Page 137
Mrs. Catherine Halpin - 72 - Cancer on side for two months, fears operation
June 27 Robert Rey - 18 - just graduated from High School on the feast of the Sacred Heart - St. James School, Ferndale - dround last Friday - Prayers are asked for recovery of his body
28 Mrs. Stella (Jos.) Ryan - 55 - gall ..
June Marie McBeth - 13 - Fitz and convulsions - sometimes 3 a day.
June 29 Dello Cogo - 60 - liver-cancer - had operation in May. Drs. did nothing but sew him up again. He was enrolled To-day. Daughter promising at least one if not all four books of "City of God", if father recovers. July 3rd - reported improving - See July 19th
Delia Martin - 64 - seven strokes in 14 yrs. - now quite helpless - Mother of ten.
Page 138 June 30 Mrs. Irene (Wines) Keeler - 30 - T.B. Eleven yrs ago, "cured" .... Married, blessed with beautiful little daughter now five. Lost a secon child. Now over three years T.B. again. Has had three major operations since April 21st losing nine ribs, etc. Now quite hopeless in oxigin coop - inscribed for " ... big surprise". in Ser. Mass As'n.
